title: apricity.anth.us deep links (/scores, /beats, /about) redirect to /x/ paths that return 404 instead of serving the SPA
description:
**Problem**
Deep links on https://apricity.anth.us, such as /scores, /beats and /about, answer 301 to a trailing-slash path, and that path answers 404 with the SPA shell as the body. Anyone who opens or refreshes a deep link gets a 404 status, and search engines and link checkers treat the pages as missing.

**Evidence**
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' https://apricity.anth.us/scores` returns `301 https://apricity.anth.us/scores/`.
- `curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://apricity.anth.us/scores` returns 404 (2026-10-20).
- customHttp.yml has headers only; there is no rewrite rule.

**Fix**
Add an Amplify rewrite so SPA routes return 200 with index.html (for example a `/<*>` to `/index.html` rewrite with status 200 that excludes asset extensions), and drop the trailing-slash redirect for those routes.

**How to verify**
`curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://apricity.anth.us/scores` returns 200, and the same for /beats and /about.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
